Prescription

Tracks customer prescription items. Save pushes your current rows to a shared database that follows this dashboard across computers — open it anywhere and click Load (or just reopen the page) to pull in whatever was last Saved, from this computer or any other. Save also uploads a copy to Prescription.xlsx in your Google Drive as a backup; Google Drive has no tool to edit a file's content in place, so each Save there uploads a brand-new file and moves the previous one to Drive's trash — its Drive ID changes on every save, so a shared link to the old file will stop working. Rows you edit here are also kept in this browser as a local fallback, so they aren't lost between saves.

Schedule auto-update

Pick a time of day (Asia/Riyadh time, regardless of what timezone this computer is set to). While this dashboard is open in a browser tab, it'll automatically run Live Update (Products + Orders), save the snapshot, and record that day's product prices into the shared database (so the same price history shows up when this dashboard is opened from another computer) once, at or after that time each day. This can't run while the dashboard is closed — a browser tab has to be open for the scheduled update to fire.
